```{r setup, include=FALSE}

  echo   = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(psych)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(ModelMetrics)  # for brier
library(scales)        # for percent_format()
library(stringr)
```

## 1. Load & Clean Data

```{r}
# 1.1 Read leaderboard JSON
df_leaderboard <- as_tibble(
  fromJSON("/Users/akn30/leaderboard_analysis/leaderboard_with_info.json")
)

# 1.2 Read evaluation metrics CSV
df <- read.csv(
  "/Users/akn30/leaderboard_analysis/optimal_threshold_results/evaluation_metrics_sensitivity_method.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 1.3 Clean team names
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    team = gsub("output_|outputs_|\\.txt|_|\\s", "", Team) %>% tolower()
  ) %>%
  select(-Team)
# fix typo
df$team[df$team == "uclpeadiatrics"] <- "uclpaediatrics"

df_leaderboard <- df_leaderboard %>%
  mutate(
    team = tolower(team) %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
  )

# 1.4 Merge and filter (bring in Inference Time & Parsimony Score)
df <- df %>%
  left_join(
    df_leaderboard %>% select(team, `Inference Time`),
    by = "team"
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(AUC >= 0.5, AUC < 0.99)
```

## 2. Select & Scale Evaluation Metrics

```{r}
metrics_cols <- c('F1', 'AUPRC', 'Net.Benefit', 'ECE')
if (all(c("Compute_1","Compute_2") %in% names(df))) {
  metrics_cols <- c(metrics_cols, "Compute_1", "Compute_2")
}

df_metrics <- df %>%
  select(all_of(metrics_cols)) %>%
  drop_na()

# scale development metrics
# 2.x Compute Inference Time scaling separately (excluded from factor analysis)
# scale development metrics
scaled_metrics <- scale(df_metrics)
scale_params <- list(
  center = attr(scaled_metrics, "scaled:center"),
  scale  = attr(scaled_metrics, "scaled:scale")
)
i_center_dev    <- mean(df$`Inference Time`, na.rm = TRUE)
i_scale_dev     <- sd(df$`Inference Time`, na.rm = TRUE)
# append to scale_params
scale_params$center["Inference Time"] <- i_center_dev
scale_params$scale["Inference Time"]  <- i_scale_dev

# === SAVE SCALE PARAMETERS ===
write_json(
  scale_params,
  "/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/scale_params.json",
  pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE
)
df_scale_params <- tibble(
  feature = names(scale_params$center),
  center  = scale_params$center,
  scale   = scale_params$scale
)
write.csv(
  df_scale_params,
  "/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/scale_params.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```



```{r}
# 3.1 KMO test
kmo <- KMO(scaled_metrics)
print(kmo)

# 3.2 Extract 1 factor
fa_result <- fa(
  scaled_metrics,
  nfactors = 1,
  rotate   = "varimax",
  scores   = "regression"
)
fa.diagram(fa_result)

# 3.3 Save loadings matrix
loadings_matrix <- as.matrix(fa_result$loadings)  # (n_metrics × 1)
write.csv(
  loadings_matrix,
  "/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/fa_factor_loadings_sen.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)
write_json(
  as.list(loadings_matrix[,1]),
  "/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/factor_loadings.json",
  pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE
)

# 3.4 Save factor‐based weights (exclude Inference Time from factor analysis)
factor_weights <- tibble(
  feature = rownames(loadings_matrix),
  weight  = loadings_matrix[,1]
)
# append fixed parsimony weight (5%) and inference time weight (5%)
parsimony_weight <- 0.05
inference_weight <- 0.05
factor_weights <- bind_rows(
  factor_weights,
  tibble(feature = "Parsimony Score",   weight = parsimony_weight),
  tibble(feature = "Inference Time",     weight = inference_weight)
)
# overwrite CSV + JSON
write.csv(
  factor_weights,
  "/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/factor_weights.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
write_json(
  factor_weights,
  "/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/factor_weights.json",
  pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE
)
```

```{r score_dev_data}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

# assume df and metrics_cols and scale_params already exist in your environment

# 1. Assemble development data
dev_data <- df %>% 
  select(team, all_of(metrics_cols), `Inference Time`)

# 2. Standardize factor‐analysis metrics
scaled_dev_metrics <- scale(
  select(dev_data, all_of(metrics_cols)),
  center = scale_params$center[metrics_cols],
  scale  = scale_params$scale[metrics_cols]
)

# 3. Standardize inference time
inf_scaled <- (dev_data$`Inference Time` - scale_params$center["Inference Time"]) /
               scale_params$scale["Inference Time"]

inf_speed <- -inf_scaled
# 4. Load factor‐analysis loadings and validation params
factor_loadings <- fromJSON("/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/factor_loadings.json")
val_params       <- fromJSON("/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/validation_scaling_params.json")

# 5. Compute raw factor score
raw_factor_dev <- as.vector(scaled_dev_metrics %*% unlist(factor_loadings))

# 6. Combine with parsimony (parsimony=1 ⇒ inv_par=0) & inference weight
wp <- 0.05; wi <- 0.05
raw_combo_dev <- raw_factor_dev * (1 - wp - wi) + (1 - 1) * wp + inf_speed * wi

# 7. Compute logistic squash parameters on raw_combo_dev
o_bs <- raw_combo_dev  # alias
mu_dev   <- median(o_bs)
tau_dev  <- sd(o_bs) / 2

# 8. Compute various scaled versions of raw_combo_dev
# 8.1 Logistic-scaled (0,1)
logistic_scale <- 1 / (1 + exp(-(raw_combo_dev - mu_dev) / tau_dev))
# 8.2 Min–Max scaling to [0,1]
minmax_scale <- (raw_combo_dev - min(raw_combo_dev)) / (max(raw_combo_dev) - min(raw_combo_dev))
# 8.3 Z‑score standardization
zscore_scale <- (raw_combo_dev - mean(raw_combo_dev)) / sd(raw_combo_dev)

# 8. Compute Z‑score standardization on raw_combo_dev as final score
mu_z <- mean(raw_combo_dev)
sd_z <- sd(raw_combo_dev)
#final_score_dev <- (raw_combo_dev - mu_z) / sd_z

# 9. Save z-score parameters for Python evaluation
z_params <- list(
  center = mu_z,
  scale  = sd_z
)
write_json(
  z_params,
  "/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/zscore_params.json",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  pretty = TRUE
)
# 9. Save results
dev_scores <- tibble(
  team           = dev_data$team,
  raw_score      = raw_combo_dev,
  logistic_score = logistic_scale,
  minmax_score   = minmax_scale,
  zscore_score   = zscore_scale
)
write.csv(
  dev_scores,
  "/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/development_scores.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 10. Merge with original df to compare metrics
comparison_df <- df %>%
  left_join(dev_scores, by = "team") %>%
  select(team, all_of(metrics_cols), TP, FP, FN, TN, raw_score, logistic_score, minmax_score, zscore_score)

# 11. Show head sorted by logistic_score
glimpse_df <- comparison_df %>%
  arrange(desc(logistic_score)) %>%
  head()
print(glimpse_df)

# 12. Plot density of different scaling methods
plot_df <- tibble(
  raw       = raw_combo_dev,
  logistic  = logistic_scale,
  minmax    = minmax_scale,
  zscore    = zscore_scale
)

plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "method", values_to = "score") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = score, color = method)) +
    geom_density(size = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title    = "Comparison of Scaling Methods on Development Weighted Scores",
      x        = "Scaled Score",
      y        = "Density"
    )

```

## 4. Validation Using Z-score Weighted Scoring

```{r validation_dev_scoring}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

# 4.1 Load data to score
new_data <- read.csv(
  "/Users/akn30/leaderboard_analysis/evaluation_metrics_sensitivity_method.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 4.2 Compute raw weighted score exactly as in development
#   - factor_loadings, scale_params, parsimony_weight (wp) and inference_weight (wi) are assumed defined above
metric_names <- names(factor_loadings)
scaled_new   <- scale(
  select(new_data, all_of(metric_names)),
  center = scale_params$center[metric_names],
  scale  = scale_params$scale[metric_names]
)
raw_factor   <- as.vector(scaled_new %*% unlist(factor_loadings))

# use parsimony_score if present, otherwise assume 1
parsimony    <- if("parsimony_score" %in% names(new_data)) new_data$parsimony_score else rep(1, nrow(new_data))
inv_parsimony <- 1 - parsimony

# normalize inference time
i_norm <- (new_data$inference_time - scale_params$center["Inference Time"]) /
          scale_params$scale["Inference Time"]

# raw combo
raw_combo <- raw_factor * (1 - wp - wi) + inv_parsimony * wp + i_norm * wi

# 4.3 Apply z-score transform using saved parameters
zparams <- fromJSON("/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/zscore_params.json")
final_z <- (raw_combo - zparams$center) / zparams$scale

# 4.4 Save scored results
new_data_scored <- new_data %>%
  mutate(
    raw_score   = raw_combo,
    final_score = final_z
  )
write.csv(
  new_data_scored,
  "/Users/aditya/leaderboard_analysis/final_scores_new_full.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

head(new_data_scored)

```
